description: This file defines the ServeCommand struct conforming to ParsableCommand, responsible for handling the 'serve' command in a command-line interface for the Swabble application. It sets up configuration loading, logging, speech pipeline starting, and processes streaming speech segments including wake word detection and transcript storage.

classes.name: ServeCommand
classes.description: A command-line command that initiates and manages the speech recognition serve process, including configuration, wake word detection, and logging.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronously executes the serve command, setting up configuration, starting speech pipeline, processing speech segments, handling wake word detection, and logging.
